description: A bearded man in a dark suit and bow tie holds up a dark comb at eye level, with a small chain in his other hand. Around him, men in top hats and frock coats crowd a long table covered with ornate boxes, combs, buttons, medallions and a few small objects. Behind them is an iron-and-glass vaulted hall with arched skylights and a faint haze. The painting appears to fill the frame edge to edge, with no visible text, signature or border.
